title: Tithingman
summary: TI'THINGMAN, noun [tithing and man.] 1. The chief man of a tithing; a headborrough; one elected to preside over the tithing. 2. A peace officer; an under constable. 3. In New England, a parish officer

inlines.v: TI'THINGMAN, noun [tithing and man.] 1. The chief man of a tithing; a headborrough; one elected to preside over the tithing. 2. A peace officer; an under constable. 3. In New England, a parish officer annually elected to preserve good order in the church during divine service, and to make complaint of any disorderly conduct.
